channel.title: MIDSEA
channel.description: Modelling Infectious Diseases in South East Asia

item.title: Dengue serotype dynamics paper accepted at Lancet ID
item.description: The network’s flagship multi-country study on dengue serotype dynamics has been accepted for publication in The Lancet Infectious Diseases. This paper represents two years of collaborative data harmonisation across six MIDSEA member countries.

item.title: MIDSEA receives Funding Award extension
item.description: We are pleased to announce that the MIDSEA network has received a three-year funding extension to continue building the regional modelling hub. The extended grant includes capacity-building grants for four new partner institutions across the region.

item.title: Response brief delivered to ASEAN health ministers
item.description: MIDSEA has delivered a policy response brief to the ASEAN health ministers’ meeting, presenting recommendations on cross-border disease surveillance informed by our model ensemble results. The brief covers dengue, malaria, and respiratory pathogens.

item.title: Meet the 2026 mentorship cohort — 24 new pairs
item.description: We are excited to announce our largest mentorship cohort to date: 24 mentor-mentee pairs spanning nine countries and six disease areas. The 2026 cohort includes researchers working on dengue, malaria, AMR, TB, respiratory infections, and zoonoses.

item.title: Open-sourcing the MIDSEA validation notebooks
item.description: We are releasing the MIDSEA validation notebook suite as open-source software. This collection of Jupyter and Quarto notebooks provides standardised checks for compartmental models, helping researchers verify that their implementations match published specifications.

item.title: Call for Bangkok 2026 session chairs
item.description: We are now accepting proposals for session chairs at the MIDSEA 2026 symposium in Bangkok. The symposium will feature six thematic tracks, and we particularly encourage applications from early-career researchers. Proposals are due by 15 May 2026.
